summary: A sound paper in the real format. Part 1 has good corrections (soprano to alto, Monday to Wednesday, 180 to 120 thousand), and in Parts 2 and 3 every option is heard and the wrong ones rejected. All answer keys are correct and in script order. Part 1 is a little short at 546 words, and the form had one line that is not in the audio. That line has been fixed.
strengths: Every MCQ in Parts 2 and 3 names all three options in the script and rejects two with a reason.
The Part 2 matching uses eight comments for six areas, and the two extra ones are plausible.
Part 4 is a clear, well-ordered lecture with one-word answers heard exactly, including proper nouns (Sumatra, Vietnam) that test spelling.

issues.problem: The first row of the Part 1 form said 'about fifty singers; no audition is needed to join', but neither fact is in the recording. A student checking the form against the audio would be confused.
issues.change: Row changed to 'new voices always needed before the spring concert', which the secretary does say.

issues.problem: The speaker says 'a hundred and twenty thousand', but the accepted answers listed only '120' and 'one hundred and twenty'.
issues.change: Added 'a hundred and twenty' as an accepted answer.

issues.problem: The Part 1 script is a little short (546 words), and Part 3 has only two speakers. Real Part 3s often have three.
issues.change: Suggestion for future sets: add one or two more exchanges to Part 1, and give the tutor a short turn in Part 3.

issues.problem: Paraphrase pairs: Q36 had the same words on both sides ('the token payment' / 'a token payment'), Q27 paired 'said yes on the spot' with 'will include', and Q30 copied the option.
issues.change: Replaced, e.g. Q36 ['grant something for almost nothing', 'a token payment'], Q27 ['The supermarket is definite', 'will the students include']. New pairs were added for Q2, Q3, Q4, Q8, Q9, Q10, Q24, Q28 and Q35.
